environment.description: Service deployed on ECS Fargate in us-east-1, fronted by an internet-facing Application Load Balancer (ALB) with a public DNS record (profile-api.example.com). Security group sg-0a1b2c3d allows inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No WAF attached. TLS terminated at ALB, forwarded to container on port 8080. Any internet client can reach the /api/v1/profile endpoint.

config.dns: profile-api.example.com (public Route53 A-record alias to ALB)
